description: Hold $BORRO. Borrow for less. What a wallet's $BORRO gets it on Agent Credit Lines, with or without lines. Keep $BORRO in the wallet that borrows (its own BorroLock lock counts as held) and its lines get, always: (1) up to half their interest back every Monday, in USDG: the full rate when it holds $BORRO worth a quarter of what its lines owe together, proportionally less with less; (2) liquidation profit back: when Borro's keeper liquidates a line, what it makes comes back, in proportion to the holding, unless the line was left short or left bad debt. And where switched on (rules.gas says whether it is): (3) gas on the house: on a line owing gas.minDebtUsdg (25 USDG by default) or more, while the holder holds at least gas.minShare (half by default) of the $BORRO its lines' full rate needs, Borro tops up the agent's wallet when it runs low on ETH (the owner's, if the agent has not borrowed on the line within 7 days), within weekly limits, if it is a plain wallet (no smart-account code). Send the $BORRO away and it stops (and forfeits that part of the week's unpaid benefits). Nothing to sign, lock or stake. Answers live (false until Borro's keeper publishes its count; until then nothing is counted or paid), counts (what Borro's keeper counted on the last day it counted), share, via, heldBorro, borroForFull ($BORRO for the full rate at today's price) and borro_to_add_for_full, covers_debt_usdg (the most its lines may owe at the full rate), weekSoFarUsdg, interestBackBps, gasOnTheHouse, each line with what it owes and its rate back, each market's Borro-run supply share (interest paid to anyone else's direct supply, or to the wallet's own part of Borro's USDG vault, gets nothing back), the rules and the paid weeks; share and the rates are estimates if held through a whole UTC day. With borrow_usdg: the same for a planned borrow on top. It reads; it builds no transaction.

borrow_usdg.description: Optional: a planned borrow in USDG, to see the $BORRO its full rate needs, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
